description: This file defines the CRExecutionContext class and related functions for evaluating JavaScript in a Chromium remote debugging session, including handling of remote objects, error rewriting, and handle creation.

classes.name: CRExecutionContext
classes.description: Implements JavaScript evaluation and property retrieval in a Chromium remote debugging session.

methods.name: rawEvaluateJSON
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression and returns the result as JSON.

methods.name: rawEvaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: evaluateWithArguments
methods.description: Calls a function with arguments within the execution context.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a remote JavaScript object.

methods.name: releaseHandle
methods.description: Releases a handle to a remote object.

methods.name: createHandle
methods.description: Creates a JSHandle for a remote object, handling nodes and other types.
